meta.description: Licensed esthetician studio in Idaho Falls. Customized facials, dermaplaning, lash lifts, brow lamination, waxing, and new LED light therapy. Book online.

hero.heading: Rosemary Esthetics
hero.lead: Licensed esthetician in Idaho Falls, Idaho. Customized facials, dermaplaning, lashes, brows, waxing, and back treatments. A quiet hour that's just for you.

services.intro: Every service is tailored to your skin and your pace. Tap a category for details, prep tips, and what to expect.

intro.heading: Hi, I'm Jillian
intro.para1: After struggling with my own skin and confidence, I discovered how much skincare can impact the way you feel. I started Rosemary Esthetics to help others feel beautiful, confident, and comfortable in their own skin.
intro.para2: I'm a licensed esthetician and a graduate of Austin Kade Academy, and every treatment here is personalized, results-driven, and genuinely relaxing.
